part.text:
Migration complete. Both routes verified (200, correct titles/content):

- `app/layout.tsx` — root layout with `<html lang="en">`/`<body>` (from `_document.tsx`) and shared metadata (viewport, favicon, title template)
- `app/page.tsx`, `app/about/page.tsx` — migrated pages; `next/head` replaced with `Metadata` exports, `<a>` replaced with `next/link` `Link`
- `pages/` (incl. `_app.tsx`, `_document.tsx`) removed
- `npm run build` passes; `/` and `/about` render identically
